redFlags.label: Flock camera network
redFlags.detail: 2 Flock Safety license-plate cameras are mapped inside Village of Hicksville's borders in OpenStreetMap. Who runs each camera is recorded for some; cameras tagged as run by stores, malls, schools or state and regional agencies are not counted.
